title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20

ai_review.summary: Flawless soundboard capture of a fall‑73 hidden gem, highlighted by a soaring Weather Report Suite and classic China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider sequence.
ai_review.review: These fan reviews agree that the patched SBD source is crystal‑clear and arguably the best available for this two‑set show. Musically the concert is described as a peak of the Fall ’73 run, with a tight first set and a second set packed with standout moments like Lay Me Down, the Let It Grow segment of Weather Report Suite, and a glowing China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider. The overall vibe is one of timeless, hypnotic magic that many consider among the band’s finest performances.

ai_rating.rationale: All nine reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star) and praise both the musical performance and the high‑quality soundboard recording, with only minor technical notes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the sound flawless, crisp and the best of the two SBD sources; patches fix missing sections but do not detract from overall clarity.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Promised Land > Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told
poor_songs: Sugar Magnolia (not as strong for some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set is described as near‑perfect and alacritous, while the second set delivers classic segues and jam vehicles that sustain the show’s hypnotic momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for perfect guitar tone; noted occasionally for a slip‑up on Truckin' but overall strong interplay.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for brilliant rhythm fills and “guitar wizard” contributions throughout the set.
